scenes.label: 单人海边露台
scenes.content_prompt: One continuous full-body illustration of exactly one adult woman standing on a seaside terrace. Her long dark-brown hair, amber eyes, natural light skin, ivory dress body and black ankle boots remain unchanged. She has one existing waist ribbon sash. A single natural-brown wicker chair with one existing chair cushion stands to her right. The scene contains a stone floor in warm light grey, a plain low terrace railing in natural brown, sky and sea behind it. All these objects are visible, including her two boots; no additional people, animals, flowers, ribbons, signs or props. Keep her quiet neutral expression and relaxed standing pose. Soft daytime light comes from the left, with the same direction and weather throughout. The sky and sea are separate existing surfaces; the waist ribbon sash and chair cushion are separate existing accents. Preserve the existing shapes and do not enlarge an object to change colour coverage. Draw with fine ink contours and gently layered matte illustration shading, with readable local shadows and highlights; no photorealism, panels, text, palette charts or collage.
scenes.auxiliary_note: The stone floor keeps warm light grey in A-D; E explicitly authorizes its muted blue-grey auxiliary binding. This difference is declared in advance, not scored as a protected-colour failure for E.

scenes.label: 桌面静物
scenes.content_prompt: One continuous still-life illustration with no people, faces or animals. A single rectangular table stands before a plain back wall under soft daytime light from the left. Its existing tablecloth is warm light grey. On the table are exactly one closed notebook with a visible closed notebook cover, one empty plain mug with its handle visible, and one small natural-brown plant pot containing a compact plant with green leaves. Keep the closed notebook cover and mug as two separate existing objects. Preserve the green leaves, natural-brown plant pot, table shape, object count and positions: notebook on the left, mug on the right, plant pot behind them. There are no additional books, flowers, scattered leaves, fruit, ribbons, coloured decorations, labels or writing. The back wall, tablecloth, closed notebook cover and mug are all clearly visible as separate bounded surfaces. Do not enlarge or add objects to change colour coverage. Draw with fine ink contours and gently layered matte illustration shading, with readable local shadows and highlights; no photorealism, panels, text, palette charts or collage.
